### FINDING_1: **Nit** `code-quality` `scripts/test-cache-key-runtime-audit.sh:141`: The missing-log-root exit-code check is substring-based, so `exit:20`, `exit:21`, etc. would still satisfy `"exit:2"` even though the harness claims to pin exit code 2. Capture the status into a variable or assert an exact line match, for example `grep -qx 'exit:2'`.
